extracted.name: Three Little Molasses Loaves
extracted.description: Been wanting to try baking this for a long time. I didn't know how to was worried about messing it up. So I slowly baked other things before trying out bread with yeast type recipes.
instruction_lines: Mix the starter ingredients and allow the yeast to bloom or to froth up.
Mix the salt and flour. Make a crater in center of flour and mix in the yeast mixture.
Knead till mixed. Oil the outside of dough and inside of bowl. Allow to rise 1 hour.
After it rises punch dough allow another hour to rise again. Separate into 3 equal parts. Cover with plastic wait the hour. Form into little American football shapes.
Preheat oven 375° Fahrenheit. Success! They rose up hay! Slice three times across the top of each loaf. Bake 25 minutes.
Remove from oven and brush with melted butter and sprinkle with oats. Put back into oven for 5-7 minutes. Allow to cool 25 minutes before serving. I hope you enjoy!!!
